text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After an incredible victory, Mejiro<n>Dober shows a
new side of herself to<n>the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Wanting as many people as possible<n>to watch her
race, she proudly<n>declares her intent to challenge
Air<n>Groove at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup<n>in front of
the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All that's left now is to wait—the<n>Queen Elizabeth II
Cup isn't too far<n>off!
